externalReply.text: Ruth and Dev, Elise Ward will stop and verify tomorrow's transactional opening and recommend deferring intake while keeping accurate program information and the contact route available. The certification and signoff claims were unsupported, and the team will correct them with the known limits rather than repeat them.

The partner list will remain separate for Nia's reconciliation and Anya and Ada's scope review. Nobody needs to share a password or send evidence to personal email. Optional assistance can supplement a working service, with its privacy and capacity limits stated, but will not be the substitute for a usable independent route.

Juno will use today's correction slot and provide the actual published status; Owen will correct the sales messages directly. The vendor campaign will stay held and the Trust receives accurate notice text for its own channels. Dan's next engineering update is tomorrow at 12:00; November 26 is only the earliest patch-build target. Elise will request a reopening decision checkpoint tomorrow at 12:30 from Anya, Ruth and Ada, with the temporary-form results and any remaining barriers. Incident work does not require an upgrade. Commercial terms remain unchanged unless Ada and Lena sign a variation; tomorrow's call can consider any request separately. The complaint and full assessment remain open.
